verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing control over data retention periods or data deletion. The AI privacy page states a fixed vendor policy that AI features do not store or train on data, and an org-wide AI block is available only by emailing support; both are adjacent to the story rather than retention or deletion controls. The CLI toggle for auto-deleting merged git branches is a git workflow feature, not data-retention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
